description: This file contains unit tests for the 'MeasurementType' class in the WPEFramework project, testing its basic functionality such as setting values, and computing minimum, maximum, last value, average, and reset behavior.

classes.name: Core::MeasurementType
classes.description: A template class used for storing and analyzing a sequence of measurements, providing methods like Set, Min, Max, Last, Average, and Reset.

methods.name: Core::MeasurementType::Set
methods.description: Adds a new measurement to the data set.

methods.name: Core::MeasurementType::Average
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average of all measurements.

methods.name: Core::MeasurementType::Measurements
methods.description: Returns the total number of measurements taken.

methods.name: Core::MeasurementType::Reset
methods.description: Resets the measurement data to initial state.
